# TextDecoration

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Text decoration styles that can be combined using bitwise OR.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `None`: No decoration
- `Underline`: Underline drawn below the text baseline
- `Strikethrough`: Line drawn through the middle of the text
- `Overline`: Line drawn above the text (over the cap height)
